head: codex/5839-birthday-governance-handoff
title: Docs: map v0.92 birthday evidence to v0.93 governance handoff
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5839

## Summary
- add the v0.92-to-v0.93 governance evidence map with row-level allowed-use, forbidden-inference, redaction, unresolved-decision, and accepting-consumer fields
- update the v0.92 next-milestone handoff and ADR 0068 planning row while keeping ADR 0068 proposed, not accepted
- add the WP-19 validator for map completeness and forbidden governance-claim checks

## Validation
- `ruby .csdlc/evidence/5839/validate-governance-handoff.rb` — PASS
- `ruby .csdlc/evidence/5839/validate-governance-handoff.rb --negative` — PASS
- `git diff --check` — PASS
- fresh exact-head review by `subagent:/root/review_5839_final_clean` — PASS

## Non-claims
- #5836 remains `blocked_with_evidence` and is not consumed as terminal birthday-demo evidence.
- The v0.93 issue wave remains candidate; this PR names the accepted v0.93 planning package as consumer, not an opened implementation owner.
- This does not grant citizenship, standing, rights, duties, legal personhood, polis authority, or completed v0.93 governance.
- No #112, #203, #122, #256, #84, AWS, decomposition, closeout, or merge work is included.
